description: This file defines the 'ShutdownReasonType' interface and its implementations 'Unknown' and the enumeration 'Known' in the context of the Eclipse Ditto project's signaling commands. It describes reasons for issuing a shutdown command, with predefined types and support for custom types.

classes.name: ShutdownReasonType
classes.description: An interface representing a reason for issuing a Shutdown command. It extends CharSequence and is annotated to be immutable.

classes.name: ShutdownReasonType.Unknown
classes.description: A final immutable class implementing ShutdownReasonType, representing an unknown reason, with a static factory method 'of(CharSequence)'.

classes.name: ShutdownReasonType.Known
classes.description: An enumeration implementing ShutdownReasonType that contains predefined reasons such as 'purge-namespace' and 'purge-entities'.

methods.name: ShutdownReasonType.of
methods.description: Creates an instance of Unknown with a given type name.

methods.name: ShutdownReasonType.forTypeName
methods.description: Retrieves a known shutdown reason type by its type name, returning an Optional.
